§06 / Honest answers

FAQ

The questions that come up before people buy — answered straight.

  • Q01

    Can I just generate these in Midjourney myself?

    Honestly, yes you can! It takes a tonne of experimenting with prompts and image references, but it's possible. I even explain a simple method to do this in the asset pack so you can generate an infinite amount of Materials.

  • Q02

    Is the quality good enough for client work?

    Fair. Materials¹ is rated 5★ from 8 verified buyers, and every Material is cleared for client and commercial work. The previews on this page are the actual files at actual quality — nothing is upscaled or touched up for the site.

  • Q03

    Do I really need 160 Materials?

    There is a fairly wide variety in the pack as it has to cater for all types of projects, and different use cases. If you only ever use 10, that's still under $1 each. Remember the Materials are there to help you create even more assets and Materials. It's literally infinite once you get going.

  • Q04

    Can I use these in client and commercial projects?

    Yes — every Material is cleared for personal and commercial use, client work included. Drop them into websites, apps, decks, video and social posts. The licence covers the work you make with them.

  • Q05

    What file formats do the Materials come in?

    Stills are 2048 × 2048 PNGs in sRGB, and every loop is a 1080p MP4 (H.264). There's a transparent PNG of each Material for layering, plus five 4K hero loops, three web hero designs, nine UI card templates and the Figma file.

  • Q06

    What's the difference between Glass Materials and Materials¹?

    Materials¹ is the older and more varied library — 160 stills, 160 loops and 160 transparent PNGs spanning every finish, from chrome and matte to iridescent, for $9. Glass Materials is the newer pack: 100 specimens in one finish, clear and refractive, with its own hero templates, guide and prompts. Take Materials¹ for range; take Glass if the clear look is what you're after. They don't overlap.
